news.title: Anthropic warns that it’s very close to RSI capability, aka self-building AI
news.summary: RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return.

news.summary: In experiments by Y Combinator Labs and Olam Labs, OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Sol model showed two very different sides.

news.title: Raising the quality of insights in agentic analytics
news.summary: In just a few years, generative AI has changed the face of enterprise analytics, notably by making analytics accessible to users across the organization.

news.title: The agentic web is here
news.summary: In 2001, a decade after he invented the World Wide Web, Tim Berners-Lee articulated a new vision.

news.title: Omen AI adds liquid know-how in $16 million Aquatic Labs acquisition

news.title: Goldman Sachs pulls AI coding tools from traders and bankers

news.title: AI elites might hoard intelligence like mercantilists hoarded gold
news.summary: Engineer Venkatesh Rao compares the fear of AI job losses to mercantilism: intelligence is treated as a scarce resource that elites want to control.

news.title: SpaceXSI apparently cuts Grok Bot quotas weeks after Musk called it his fastest-growing product
news.summary: SpaceXSI is apparently cutting usage limits for its AI agent Grok Bot, less than two weeks after Musk called it his fastest-growing product.

news.title: Stop counting tokens, start counting what ships
news.summary: When a developer gives an AI agent a coding task, the agent does more than answer once. It plans, generates code, runs tests, and repeats the process to correct errors.
